# SMA MEP Estimate

> > Professional MEP cost estimation and takeoff services specializing in electrical, communications, and electronic safety systems for construction projects.

SMA MEP Estimate provides comprehensive estimating services aligned with industry standards from AACE, ASPE, and PMI. The company specializes in Division 26 (Electrical), Division 27 (Communications), and Division 28 (Electronic Safety and Security) cost estimation, quantity surveying, and construction bidding support with zip-code-based pricing.

## Key Topics

- Electrical Estimating
- Electrical Takeoff Services
- MEP Cost Estimation
- Division 26 – Electrical
- Division 27 – Communications
- Division 28 – Electronic Safety and Security
- Construction Bidding
- Quantity Surveying
- AACE Standards
- ASPE Methodology
- PMI Compliance
- Zip Code Pricing
- Cost Engineering
- Takeoff Services
- Construction Estimation
